MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer | CI/CD and Test Infrastructure
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with experience owning CI/CD pipelines and building test infrastructure for three product teams. Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and improved end-to-end test reliability from a 7% flaky rate to below 1%. Hands-on with GitLab CI, Docker, Helm and namespace-level Kubernetes deployments, with additional personal experience operating a k3s GitOps homelab and provisioning a Hetzner VPS with Terraform. Seeking a move into a DevOps or platform engineering role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose
Infrastructure: Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level access and test-environment deployments), k3s, Terraform (personal project)
Monitoring and TLS: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, cert-manager, TLS certificate management
Cloud learning: AWS EC2 and S3 fundamentals (personal learning)
Programming and data: Python, Bash, Java (test code), SQL, PostgreSQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Other: Linux, Git, Ansible (basic)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021 - Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages and artifact publishing.
- Built short-lived merge-request environments for the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, deployed via Helm to the shared Kubernetes cluster from GitLab CI; environments are removed automatically after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by profiling pipelines, parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests; reduced monthly CI runner costs by about 30%.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Python and Bash tooling for test-data seeding; collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and built Grafana dashboards to track flaky tests.
- Wrote internal documentation on how CI works, used in onboarding, and mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019 - 2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated testing.
- Introduced a Java and Selenium automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018 - 2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

PROJECTS
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal project | 2024 - 2025
- Ran a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, deploying applications from a Git repository with Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS; provisioned a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform and used Ansible (basic).

EDUCATION
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Preparing for Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA); exam scheduled for January 2027 (not yet passed).

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role. The opportunity to help build the infrastructure for Corvale's new train fleet, from early design through production, particularly interests me. My experience is strongest in CI/CD, deployment automation and test infrastructure, where I have made delivery workflows faster and test environments easier for teams to use.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines serving three product teams and built short-lived merge-request environments deployed with Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster. The environments include the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, and are automatically removed after merge or inactivity. I also reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and helped reduce the end-to-end test flaky rate from 7% to below 1%. I documented how the CI system works for onboarding and built Grafana dashboards so teams could identify flaky-test trends.

I have also built a personal k3s homelab using Argo CD, with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS; I provisioned a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform. My Kubernetes work at Odrava is limited to namespace-level access on a shared cluster, and my Terraform and AWS EC2/S3 exposure is from personal learning rather than production cloud operations. I would bring this practical automation and test-infrastructure experience while continuing to grow into broader cloud platform ownership.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building reliable delivery workflows and observable test environments could contribute to Corvale's fleet-connectivity platform.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
